name: Keel
author: Erin Carter
description: A burning-ship-style abs-folded Julia set: a single glowing coastline creased into keel-lines and rigging-like tendrils, a dark vessel run aground in near-black. A hidden seed sweeps a slow closed arc and the whole wreck continuously rebuilds itself — tendrils extend and dissolve, creases migrate, the boundary becomes a different boundary without ever travelling.

params.label: Fold mix
params.effect: Blends the iteration from a smooth quadratic Julia (0) to the fully abs-folded burning-ship form (1), melting the creased hull into soft lace and back.

params.label: Writhe speed
params.effect: Speed of the seed's arc — how quickly the wreck rebuilds itself.

params.label: Zoom
params.effect: Magnification about the composition centre, from the whole wreck to one stretch of creased hull.

params.label: Glow reach
params.effect: Depth of the luminous escape-band margin clinging to the silhouette before it falls to black.
